decision_summary.method_formulation_markdown: For independent scalar outcomes $Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$ with finite variance, the target is the population mean $\mu=E(Y)$. The retained illustrative interface fits the constant-mean relationship $Y_i=\mu+\varepsilon_i$, with $E(\varepsilon_i)=0$, by squared error: $$\widehat\mu=\arg\min_m\sum_{i=1}^n(Y_i-m)^2=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^nY_i.$$ Here $m$ is a candidate mean and the returned estimate is in outcome units. The interface requires at least two finite values and reports the sample standard error. This recaps [retained illustrative model code](artifact://artifact.example.implementation.model.py), not an executed or published research evaluation.
